items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tall, lanky fellow plays clarinet. And he was down here first with Buddy Petit. You remember Buddy? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I know Buddy Petit.

ctx.x: Tall, lanky fellow plays clarinet. And he was down here first with Buddy Petit. You remember Buddy?
Yeah, I know Buddy Petit. You know all of them.
